angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the record's radius at the Gaia distance.

radiusSource: Radius 1.77 +/- 0.05 solar radii, temperature 8840 +/- 200 K and mass 1.96 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Chauvin et al. (2017, A&A 605, L9; arXiv:1707.01413), Table 1: an isochrone radius and a temperature from the A2V spectral type (Pecaut calibration), not a measured disc. 1,231,389 km at 695,700 km per solar radius; GM from 1.96 solar masses, the stellar mass Blunt et al. (2023) adopt for the orbit placed here, times the JPL solar GM. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
effectiveTemperatureSource: 8840 +/- 200 K, Chauvin et al. (2017), A&A 605, L9, Table 1, https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.01413

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its colour is Gaia's spectrum of it.
